name: workbench
description: Local copy of eascend's Workbench: a side pane and a band above the prompt, in every session. In a project with .claude/plans or .claude/docs it shows For you, Plan, Tracks, Handoffs and Research from those files and the current-status report. No tasks: the plans/ Tasks box, /task and the work_items tool are removed.

open_pane.title: Open the pane at start
open_pane.description: on opens the Workbench pane with every session; off leaves it closed until /workbench:task or the band's Workbench button.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: on shows the current task and its progress above the prompt; off hides it.

follow_macos.title: Match macOS light and dark
follow_macos.description: on keeps Claude Code's theme on light or dark to match macOS appearance, so skins and the pane redraw for the right background; off leaves the theme alone.
